title: Name That LLM: the demo and its models
description: P6: the public demo's anonymous events (Grafana Faro) and the models' scores over time.

panels.title: Visits (the page loaded)
panels.description: Each visit loads the champion once: page_load events from real visitors.

panels.title: Load and answer times (ms)
panels.description: Load: downloading and reading the 15 MB model. Answer: the champion's prediction, on the visitor's device.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.5, {service_name="name-that-llm-demo", kind="event"} | logfmt | event_name="page_load" | event_data_synthetic="false" | event_data_what="champion" | unwrap event_data_load_ms | __error__="" [$__interval]) by ()

quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name="name-that-llm-demo", kind="event"} | logfmt | event_name="page_load" | event_data_synthetic="false" | event_data_what="champion" | unwrap event_data_load_ms | __error__="" [$__interval]) by ()

quantile_over_time(0.5, {service_name="name-that-llm-demo", kind="event"} | logfmt | event_name="answer" | event_data_synthetic="false" | unwrap event_data_answer_ms | __error__="" [$__interval]) by ()

quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name="name-that-llm-demo", kind="event"} | logfmt | event_name="answer" | event_data_synthetic="false" | unwrap event_data_answer_ms | __error__="" [$__interval]) by ()

panels.title: Errors, by where they happened
panels.description: The alert fires above 5 real errors in an hour.

targets.expr: sum by (event_data_where) (count_over_time({service_name="name-that-llm-demo", kind="event"} | logfmt | event_name="error" | event_data_synthetic="false" [$__interval]))

panels.title: The robot visitor: answers and answer time
panels.description: The scheduled robot (every 6 hours, ?synthetic=1). The alert fires when it hasn't answered for 12 hours.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.5, {service_name="name-that-llm-demo", kind="event"} | logfmt | event_name="answer" | event_data_synthetic="true" | unwrap event_data_answer_ms | __error__="" [$__interval]) by ()

panels.title: The models on real texts ("Do you know who wrote it?")
Champion: share right, on answers naming one of the 18 models
panels.description: Per champion run: the share of visitors' answers it named right, and how many answers there were. Few answers make a wide margin: the weekly export computes the intervals.

targets.expr: (sum by (event_data_model_run) (count_over_time({service_name="name-that-llm-demo", kind="event"} | logfmt | event_name="feedback" | event_data_synthetic="false" | event_data_actual!="a person" | event_data_actual!="another model" | label_format right=`{{ if eq .event_data_actual .event_data_label }}1{{ else }}0{{ end }}` | right="1" [$__range])) or 0 * sum by (event_data_model_run) (count_over_time({service_name="name-that-llm-demo", kind="event"} | logfmt | event_name="feedback" | event_data_synthetic="false" | event_data_actual!="a person" | event_data_actual!="another model" [$__range]))) / sum by (event_data_model_run) (count_over_time({service_name="name-that-llm-demo", kind="event"} | logfmt | event_name="feedback" | event_data_synthetic="false" | event_data_actual!="a person" | event_data_actual!="another model" [$__range]))

sum by (event_data_model_run) (count_over_time({service_name="name-that-llm-demo", kind="event"} | logfmt | event_name="feedback" | event_data_synthetic="false" | event_data_actual!="a person" | event_data_actual!="another model" [$__range]))

panels.title: Champion vs challenger, on the same texts (counts)
panels.description: Shadow mode: on the texts the challenger also scored, how many each model named right. Counts, not shares: the weekly export computes the paired comparison and its intervals.

targets.expr: sum by (event_data_challenger_run) (count_over_time({service_name="name-that-llm-demo", kind="event"} | logfmt | event_name="feedback" | event_data_synthetic="false" | event_data_actual!="a person" | event_data_actual!="another model" | event_data_challenger_label!="" [$__range]))

sum by (event_data_challenger_run) (count_over_time({service_name="name-that-llm-demo", kind="event"} | logfmt | event_name="feedback" | event_data_synthetic="false" | event_data_actual!="a person" | event_data_actual!="another model" | event_data_challenger_label!="" | label_format right=`{{ if eq .event_data_actual .event_data_label }}1{{ else }}0{{ end }}` | right="1" [$__range])) or 0 * sum by (event_data_challenger_run) (count_over_time({service_name="name-that-llm-demo", kind="event"} | logfmt | event_name="feedback" | event_data_synthetic="false" | event_data_actual!="a person" | event_data_actual!="another model" | event_data_challenger_label!="" [$__range]))

sum by (event_data_challenger_run) (count_over_time({service_name="name-that-llm-demo", kind="event"} | logfmt | event_name="feedback" | event_data_synthetic="false" | event_data_actual!="a person" | event_data_actual!="another model" | event_data_challenger_label!="" | label_format right=`{{ if eq .event_data_actual .event_data_challenger_label }}1{{ else }}0{{ end }}` | right="1" [$__range])) or 0 * sum by (event_data_challenger_run) (count_over_time({service_name="name-that-llm-demo", kind="event"} | logfmt | event_name="feedback" | event_data_synthetic="false" | event_data_actual!="a person" | event_data_actual!="another model" | event_data_challenger_label!="" [$__range]))

panels.title: Answers, by the author the visitor gave
panels.description: How many answers each author got, in the time range.

targets.expr: sum by (event_data_actual) (count_over_time({service_name="name-that-llm-demo", kind="event"} | logfmt | event_name="feedback" | event_data_synthetic="false" [$__range]))

panels.title: Drift: are the texts like our passages?

targets.expr: sum by (event_data_words) (count_over_time({service_name="name-that-llm-demo", kind="event"} | logfmt | event_name="answer" | event_data_synthetic="false" [$__range]))

panels.title: Predicted models
panels.description: On our passages, each model wrote 1 in 18 (5.6%).

targets.expr: sum by (event_data_label) (count_over_time({service_name="name-that-llm-demo", kind="event"} | logfmt | event_name="answer" | event_data_synthetic="false" [$__range]))
sum by (event_data_band) (count_over_time({service_name="name-that-llm-demo", kind="event"} | logfmt | event_name="answer" | event_data_synthetic="false" [$__range]))

panels.title: Unusual texts, by reason
panels.description: About 1% of our held-out passages show unknown_words; none are short or non-Latin.

targets.expr: sum by (event_data_unusual) (count_over_time({service_name="name-that-llm-demo", kind="event"} | logfmt | event_name="answer" | event_data_synthetic="false" [$__range]))

panels.title: On our own passages, for reference

options.content: **Our 2,699 training passages:** 36 to 274 words; each of the 18 models wrote 1 in 18. The page flags a text as unusual under 36 words, over 22.9% unknown words (1% of our held-out passages are), or over 20% non-Latin letters. Real texts that drift far from this make the answers less trustworthy.
